frontage.reason: The north arrow at the left margin points straight up the sheet. Lot 12's street edge is its lower-left boundary on Lemac St, marked 60, on the curved section labeled R=170. There the street edge runs from upper-left to lower-right, so the lot faces outward to the southwest. Because the front edge is a curve, this direction is approximate.

Its rear edge, on the angled common line with lots 9 and 10, is marked 52.30. No single width or depth is defined, so neither is reported.
The parcel number is read as '12' from the circle in lot 12. The full AIN 2202-004-012 matches the map number 2202 page 4 and the circled 12.
